summary: Random Forest classifier achieves higher stratified 5-fold cross-validated ROC-AUC (0.906977) compared to Logistic Regression (0.820162) on the Adult Income dataset. The difference of 0.086814 was consistent across 5 repeated runs.
methodological_choices: Models: scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier() and LogisticRegression() with default hyperparameters. Evaluation: Stratified 5-fold cross-validation with ROC-AUC scoring. Preprocessing: Missing values in categorical features (workclass, occupation, native-country) filled with 'Unknown'. All categorical variables encoded using LabelEncoder. Target binary encoded (1 for >50K, 0 for <=50K). No scaling applied (RF invariant to scaling, LogReg uses max_iter=1000). No class weighting or resampling applied.
verification_method: 5-fold repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation with random seeds 42-46. Computed ROC-AUC difference across all repetitions to assess stability of finding.
verification_result: Finding held up consistently. Across 5 repetitions, Random Forest won 5/5 times. Mean difference: 0.086498 (±0.000460), 95% CI: [0.085595, 0.087400]. Conclusion: Robust finding.
